jobs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: separate transparent animal action. Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: transparent CLOSE VIEW of the SAME rabbit for a preschool story's final reveal. Rabbit faces LEFT, with head and upper chest/forepaws in a close three-quarter side view. It nibbles the leafy GREEN edge of one pale-green cabbage leaf held naturally in the mouth. The leaf extends a short distance LEFT from mouth, so the tiny incisors remain visible beside the bite. Enough actual native detail to identify eye, nose, small teeth and leaf veins when printed. Pure alpha background, no floor, halo, fake labels, arrows, writing or other animals. Square composition, one animal.
